items.title: From “It Runs Locally” to Production-Ready
items.summary:
Getting a distributed application to run on a developer’s machine is only the beginning. Production readiness requires reliable configuration, observability, testing, deployment, and the ability to diagnose failures across multiple services.

In this Short, author Fiodar Sazanavets explains how How to Ship Distributed Systems with Confidence helps .NET developers close that gap using practical guidance and .NET Aspire.

Learn more about the book: https://hubs.la/Q04t8BbY0

items.title: How Do You Test Distributed Systems Before Production Does?
items.summary:
Distributed systems can fail in ways that are difficult to reproduce—from broken service dependencies and network issues to configuration errors and unexpected integration behavior. If testing doesn’t reflect the complete system, production may uncover the problems first.

In this Short, Fiodar Sazanavets explains how developers can test distributed applications more realistically and catch issues earlier with .NET Aspire.

Learn more in How to Ship Distributed Systems with Confidence:
https://hubs.la/Q04t8BbY0
